source.prompt: Create a production sprite sheet of TWELVE original hand-painted fantasy RPG status icons on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, arranged in an exact regular grid of THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows. Portrait 3:4 canvas. Each square cell contains exactly one standalone icon, centered, with at least 10% transparent padding on every side. No text, labels, letters, grid lines, borders, plates, scenery or watermarks. Premium sculptural painted game UI art, simplified chunky forms, crisp silhouettes, bright ivory highlights, saturated midtones, extremely few details. Must be identifiable reduced to 20px. No dark black silhouettes. Consistent warm directional lighting. Every icon occupies about 80% of its cell. These are original symbolic designs, not known characters. Exact order left to right, top to bottom: ROW 1: (1) BLESSED: large luminous golden eight-point sunburst with bright ivory center and a pair of small upward-swept gold wings, strong welcoming holy radiance. (2) BLINDED: one large ivory human eye covered completely by one broad crimson cloth blindfold tied at one side, no visible pupil. (3) DEAFENED: one large warm ivory human ear with a thick red diagonal slash floating across it, instantly clear. ROW 2: (4) DODGING: bright teal upper body of an adventurer leaning sharply to the left, a single large ivory arrow missing past their right shoulder, two broad gold motion sweeps, clear evasive movement. (5) EXHAUSTION: close-up weary adult face, sagging closed eyelids, deeply drooping brows, head resting heavily on one broad palm, warm pale face with russet sleeve, large bold forms. (6) HIDDEN: close-up of a teal hood with a bright ivory cloth mask covering lower face, only two alert amber eyes visible in deep hood shadow, hood edges brightly lit, strong triangular outline, no torso. ROW 3: (7) INCAPACITATED: one large open ivory gauntleted hand with limp drooping fingers pointing downward, a bold red circular prohibition ring and slash behind the hand, clear inability to act, simple. (8) INVISIBLE: one translucent icy cyan head-and-shoulders silhouette dissolving into three broad separated pale blue wisps along its right edge, luminous clear contour and transparent interior, no hood. (9) PETRIFIED: one large grey stone classical humanoid head and shoulders, bright grey stone face and thick pedestal, two broad cracks and rigid blank stone eyes, unmistakably a stone statue. ROW 4: (10) PRONE: compact side view of one adult adventurer lying face-down horizontally, one bent arm with palm planted, face looking to the side while conscious, amber tunic and ivory head, broad clear body silhouette, no ground/scenery. (11) RESTRAINED: two large warm ivory wrists side by side upright, bound together by three thick intact golden hemp rope loops with a large central knot, no breaking ropes, hands and binding fill cell. (12) UNCONSCIOUS: close-up adult head tilted sideways resting on one open palm, both eyes fully closed, relaxed neutral mouth, bright ivory face and blue hair, a single large pale crescent moon above the forehead; no letters. Preserve exact grid positions and generous clear separation between icons.

For the user's requested cast variety, portray a mature adult woman with rich medium-brown skin, a long angular face, broad nose, full lips, and black hair in a compact braided bun, with a few silver strands at temples. Neutral closed mouth, subtle tension in brow. No visible eyes through the cloth. Red band and simple trailing knot at side; limited hair mass. A small hint of a worn brown leather adventurer collar below the chin. Same warm painted skin and fabric rendering as style anchor; clean face planes, no beauty makeup, no generic young male face.

editHistory.prompt: Revise this fantasy RPG PARALYZED condition icon. Keep ONLY its cohesive premium hand-painted rendering, teal clothing color and transparent background. REPLACE the character, pose and tension marks. ONE isolated icon, square transparent canvas, no labels, frame, scenery or ground. New character: an older dark-skinned woman approximately 55, short close-cropped salt-and-pepper tightly coiled hair, broad rounded face, broad nose, full lips, visible mature cheek and forehead lines, sturdy build. She must have genuinely different skull proportions and features from the young narrow-faced male reference, not a recoloring or gender-swap of that same face. Warm clear light across deep brown skin so features remain readable at tiny size. Simple teal sleeveless fantasy tunic with muted ivory neckline, no armor ornament. Pose: front-facing figure shown from crown through upper thighs, BOTH ARMS HELD DEAD STRAIGHT DOWN ALONG HER SIDES, elbows fully extended, shoulders rigidly drawn upward, hands held stiff alongside thighs with fingers straight together. NO bent elbows, no raised hands, no prayer gesture. Head tilted upward slightly, chin raised, eyes open wide looking a little above the viewer, tense raised inner brows and slightly parted lips expressing discomfort and alarm: awake and trapped in a motionless body, not shouting. Plain rigid silhouette. On EACH side of her body, outside the arm with clear transparent separation, place TWO VERY PROMINENT long thick ivory-gold angular SQUIGGLY muscle-lock lines, each extending approximately from shoulder height to wrist height, with 4 broad bends. They should be about 3 times the length and twice the weight of the old short squiggles. Long rounded-end zigzag contour marks, NOT arrow-shaped lightning bolts, not lightning branching across the person. They frame both arms and dominate as a recognisable simple cue at 20px. Compact centered arrangement, fit all marks and full hands well within middle 80% canvas, keep generous transparent border for circular crop. Broad painted forms, crisp silhouette, no fine detail or tiny glints, strong midtone contrast. No electricity arcs, glowing rings, runes, chains, ropes, frozen ice, extra limbs, text, numbers or watermark.

Preserve the rigid raised shoulders, BOTH ARMS LOCKED STRAIGHT DOWN AT HER SIDES with hands by the thighs, composition and anatomy. Preserve the FOUR prominent thick ivory-gold squiggly tension marks in their positions and lengths. Preserve the hand-painted sculptural game-art rendering, broad shapes and strong contrast. Replace the modern-looking sleeveless top and matching pants with convincing practical medieval fantasy ADVENTURER clothing: a weathered deep teal woven tunic with a short split neckline closed by three clearly visible crossed leather laces over an ivory linen undershirt; sleeves rolled to just above the elbows; a broad worn brown leather belt with one plain aged-brass buckle around the waist; sturdy scuffed brown leather forearm bracers secured by simple straps, wrists and hands exposed; dark earthy brown travel trousers visible below the tunic hem. Use subtle stitched edging and travel wear, but no ornamental clutter. Costume must clearly read as a seasoned tabletop fantasy adventurer at icon size, with the laced neckline, belt and bracers the dominant costume cues. No modern tank top, athletic wear, zippers or plastic. No weapons, held objects, shoulder armor, cape, jewelry, backpack or extra props. Keep the arms straight, not bent and not holding the belt. No new effects or extra symbols. Keep transparent background and generous clear space around the entire silhouette. Output ONE isolated square icon, no text, borders, panels or watermark.
